name: desk
description: The desk's app (design-015): the REAL desk since D2a-world — React 19 over createCanvasEngine, the mat and its objects drawn FROM THE WORLD through deskLayer(); plus D1's parity page (parity.html). Rigs: rig:parity (Chrome = Node through the oracle's own desk), rig:world (Chrome = Node FROM THE WORLD), rig:interact (the prototype's grammar), rig:idle (0 submits at rest), rig:portal (the mini mats' live insides, the cut and the zoom-through — D2b), rig:nav (the flights, the gesture, the press + double-click cut — D2b), rig:sticky (the note's text: the hand, the editor, typing as a gesture — D2c), rig:two-tab (a typed note crossing a ?room= when its session commits — D2c).
